justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/math/package-info.java, NumberUtils.java (1821 LOC), Fraction.java (923 LOC), and IEEE754rUtils.java (261 LOC). The package contains only 3 concrete classes (3039 LOC total), and their responsibilities are tightly cohesive numeric utilities: number parsing/conversion/comparison/min-max in NumberUtils, an immutable fraction type in Fraction, and IEEE-754 min/max helpers in IEEE754rUtils. This looks like a focused math utility package, not an excessively large or responsibility-centralizing God Component.
